title: Below about £5, the fixed fee is the price
subtitle: Stripe's standard UK card rate is 1.5% plus 20p. The same fee, on four payments.
alt: Four tiles. On a £20 payment the card fee is 2.5%. On £5 it is 5.5%. On 50p it is 41.5%. On 10p the fee is more than the payment. Below: payments of pence only work aggregated.

tiles.label: of a 10p payment
tiles.detail: the fee is more than the payment

note: So payments of pence only work aggregated: one charge a year that covers many things, or a platform that already holds a balance and settles in bulk. The fees in pence are this drawing's arithmetic from the chapter's rate; recheck the rate and date it before print.
